summary: V2 Spell Generation Pipeline testing completed. 6/7 tests passed. The 4-stage pipeline (Archivist → Planner → Writer → QA) is working for all 4 guides. One intermittent issue found: step count validation sometimes allows spells with fewer than 3 steps to pass QA.

minor.issue: QA validation allows spells with <3 steps to pass. Seen 'TOO_FEW_STEPS: 1 < 3' and 'TOO_FEW_STEPS: 2 < 3' in logs. The QA verdict logic requires 3+ HIGH violations to trigger rewrite, so single step count violation passes.

passed_tests: TestSpellConfigV2::test_get_spell_config_v2 - Config endpoint returns all belief modes, guides, structures
TestMetadataAndTiming::test_metadata_contains_timing - Metadata contains timing and all 4 stages

failed_tests.note: Intermittent - second run passed with 3 steps. LLM sometimes generates fewer steps than required.

action_items: Consider lowering QA rewrite threshold from 3 HIGH violations to 1-2 for critical structure checks like step_count
Or mark step_count as CRITICAL severity instead of HIGH to ensure rewrite is triggered
critical_code_review_comments: 4-stage pipeline (Archivist → Planner → Writer → QA) is well-implemented and working
All 4 guides (shigg, cathleen, katherine, theresa) generate spells correctly
Belief modes (SECULAR, SPIRITUAL, PRACTITIONER) are properly validated and default to SPIRITUAL for invalid values
Hard limits are checked but not strictly enforced - spells with violations are logged as warnings but still returned
QA verdict logic in /app/backend/prompts/qa.py line 208: requires 3+ HIGH violations to trigger rewrite - this allows single violations to pass
Persona-lock validation works correctly (props, sensory_cue, signature_move)
Sources are cited (2-5 per spell) - validated correctly
Materials count (2-7) and steps count (3-7) validation exists but enforcement is lenient
Every step has 'why' field with explanation - validated correctly
Response times are ~80-90 seconds per spell due to multiple LLM calls (DeepSeek + GPT-4o)
test_credentials: No authentication required for V2 endpoints (optional user for spell count tracking)
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - tests use live LLM generation
context_for_next_testing_agent: V2 spell generation pipeline tested. All 4 guides work. Intermittent step count issue found - QA allows <3 steps sometimes. Test file at /app/tests/test_spell_v2_pipeline.py covers config endpoint, all guides with different belief modes, invalid belief mode handling, and metadata/timing validation.
